privacy_notice: Readings are saved so we can show your history and weave continuity. No account needed — we use a cookie to remember you on this device. We also track anonymous, aggregate events (like 'someone completed a reading') so we can tell if the product is working. We never log your cards, your prediction text, your IP, or your identity.
apoiar_intro: Ask The Deck is a free tarot reading made by one person. It exists because I wanted to mix code with something that doesn't quite belong to code. No reading is stored under your name, and nobody pays to be here.
apoiar_cost_body: Each reading costs about $0.003 in API calls to the language model behind the scenes. I've put $20 into DeepSeek credits so far. Hosting runs on Cloudflare's free tier — zero, for now. I cover all of it.
apoiar_what_heading: What donations do — and don't do
apoiar_what_do: They cover API calls and, eventually, hosting when traffic outgrows the free tier. They buy me time to keep maintaining and improving this.
apoiar_what_dont: They don't unlock anything. There's no premium tier. Readings aren't more accurate for donors. No priority queue, no exclusive deck, no "thank you" email worth your inbox.
apoiar_other_body: If donating isn't your thing, sharing a reading or sending feedback also helps.
apoiar_about_body: "Ask The Deck" is a reference to "Ask the Dust" by John Fante — a novel about Arturo Bandini trying to establish himself as a writer, wrestling with creative ambition and the reality of finishing projects. The name is intentional: just as Arturo asked the dust, here we ask the cards. Both are ways of talking to something larger when we need clarity.
apoiar_blog_intro: I wrote about building this project and finishing something for the first time in years:
